Thank you for writing to the Companion Animal Travel Desk. We understand that you are concerned about the handling of your companion animal’s travel arrangements and the care process from booking through pickup. In your message, you note that your expectations for calm coordination were not fully met and that communication left you unsure about what to do next.

Aurelia Skyways coordinates companion animal travel with a focus on humane, low-stress handling and clear internal coordination. Our desk works with the operational team to confirm that each step is aligned, including the preparation of the crate and the calm transfer of the animal between phases of the journey. If anything appears inconsistent with that standard, we treat it as a service issue and review the associated logistics to determine where the breakdown occurred and how to prevent recurrence.

When the concern involves a lost or misplaced crate, please know that <<FACT F118>>. If your crate is located after the claim window closes, we may still be able to assist with practical next steps, but eligibility for the standard incident resolution will depend on the documented filing status. We encourage you to keep any relevant receipts, crate identifiers, and boarding details so the coordinator can match the case quickly and accurately.

For the incident resolution side, <<FACT F112>>. Where there are additional complications, our senior coordinator may request supporting documentation to verify circumstances and ensure the correct outcome for your file. Our goal is to resolve the matter in a way that is consistent, humane, and transparent, and to restore confidence in how your companion animal is cared for.

We also recognize the value of direct updates during disruption. If your travel plan included contact points that you expected us to use, we will check that routing and improve the communication path for your next journey.

Thank you again for bringing this to our attention, and we will ensure your case is handled with care.  

Companion Animal Travel Desk
